articles.name: Frieren boxes are live, with a November 3 pickup deadline
articles.keywords: frieren-signature-style-collection Nexon's Classic World store now sells the Frieren Signature Style Collection. Each 7,900 NX box gives one random set; ten cost 79,000 NX. The three Frieren variants are 1.5% each, the lowest individual rates; sales close October 7 at 4:59 PM PDT. Nexon's Classic page links this collection to the all-worlds article, which links the published rate table. That chain is why these rates apply to Classic World. Rates: Frieren's three variants 1.5% each; Himmel 2.5%; Fern 7%; Übel and Stark 8% each; Aura and Linie 20% each; Lügner 30%. Each Frieren variant has the lowest individual rate at 1.5%. Together, the three Frieren outcomes total 4.5% per box. The 79,000 NX option is ten boxes at full price. It gives ten random rolls and no discount or stated guarantee. Nexon lists a 7-day collection duration. Our current reading is the unopened box and coupons are timed, while opened outfit items are permanent until Nexon clarifies. Classic items arrive at Grand Launch. Claim them October 23 through November 3 at 11:59 PM UTC; after that deadline, they are no longer available. Boxes and opened items can move between your Classic characters through Cash Inventory. Selector coupons, hair, and face styles cannot; eligible duplicates will have a Classic-only redemption system. If you are chasing Frieren specifically, your rate is 1.5% per version. Open every box and coupon quickly: we are treating the finished outfits as permanent unless Nexon says otherwise. event Nexon

articles.name: Maple Fest tickets are on sale, and every one carries Classic World items
articles.keywords: maple-fest-2026-tickets-classic-world-rewards MapleStory Fest 2026 tickets include Classic World items. The show is October 17 at The Hill in Universal City, Los Angeles. Tickets cost $220 for Bronze, $270 for Silver, and $320 for Gold. Every tier gets a permanent Staff Chair, a Ring Exchange Box with two permanent rings, and a 30-day Maple Snail pet. Bronze gets one each of the Special Hat Exchange Box, Mystery Hair Coupon, and Mystery Face Coupon. Silver gets two; Gold gets three. Each hat box offers the Octopus Hat, Orange Mushroom Hat, or Slime Hat. Only accounts made before July 10, 2026 can buy tickets. Each account can buy up to three. Choose the reward character by August 27 at 12:00 PM Pacific. That choice also locks the character shown on your badge. Nexon says a ticket gets no Classic World items unless you choose a character before the deadline. Our release-date guide has the full reward and item-duration table. event real-world-event Nexon
